title: Item:Emerald Claw Nugget
wikitext:
==Emerald Claw Nugget==
* This quest requires access to any part of [[The Necropolis]] story arc. Talk to [[Pok Tranh]] in the Necropolis to acquire this quest and the Emerald Claw Nugget item. 
* This is a 4-tier item that needs to be upgraded in certain altars at the end of each quest series. 

===First Upgrade===
This can be done at [[The Bloody Crypt]] (Necro 1), [[The Shadow Crypt]] (N2), [[The Cursed Crypt]] (N3) or [[Accursed Ascension]] (N4) altars.
* [[Emerald Claw Amulet]] - [[Necklace]]: Cause Fear (CL:1, 3/rest), Diplomacy +3

===Second Upgrade===
This can be done at [[The Shadow Crypt]] (N2), [[The Cursed Crypt]] (N3) or [[Accursed Ascension]] (N4) altars.
* [[Emerald Claw Pendant]] - [[Necklace]]: Symbol of Fear (CL:11, 3/rest), Diplomacy +7, Intimidate +7

===Third Upgrade===
This can be done at [[The Cursed Crypt]] (N3) or [[Accursed Ascension]] (N4) altars.
* [[Emerald Claw Talisman]] - [[Necklace]]: Symbol of Fear (CL:11, 3/rest), Diplomacy +11, Intimidate +11, Fearsome

===Final Upgrade===
This can only be done at the [[Accursed Ascension]] (Necro 4) altar. The [[Emerald Claw Talisman]] will become a simple gem again. Talk to [[Pok Tranh]] to get any one of the following quest completion rewards:
{{:Category:Emerald Claw Nugget reward items}}

==Notes==
* If you have any upgraded version of the Emerald Claw Nugget (amulet, pendant or talisman), talking and accepting the [[Silver Flame Nugget]] from Jakob Izakanos will delete the Emerald Claw nugget and replace it with an un-upgraded Silver Flame nugget.
